name: Somogyhatvan (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and green in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Somogyhatvan (a blue shield with a green wavy bend and a bird) below the name SOMOGYHATVAN.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
